name: Gloomcore
summary: Gloomcore is an internet aesthetic primarily composed of liminal and dreamlike imagery of forests, beaches, and other similar landscapes.
description: Gloomcore is an internet aesthetic primarily composed of liminal and dreamlike imagery of forests, beaches, and other similar landscapes. It often expresses elements of the odd and otherworldly through these liminal/dreamlike themes and emphasizes the connection between the natural and the surreal. Gloomcore is primarily an aesthetic of visuals, not fashion or music. Individuals who partake in Gloomcore often enjoy the strange as a whole, and find beauty in silence: skies, coastlines and forests, all shrouded in fog.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Peace; liminality; enjoyment of solitude; love for all things mysterious and dark.

visualDNA.colour: Muted shades of green, brown, and grey.

fashion.Overview: Gloomcore has much looser guidelines to its fashion than other aesthetics have. It encompasses several overall qualities, and within those qualities, can have much variation. The fashion takes inspiration from the fashion styles associated with Goblincore and Forestpunk, as well as general alternative fashion. Overall, the fashion is meant to be comfortable and often warm, since the climates seen in the visuals are often quite cold. Items from each category (tops, bottoms, etc.) are commonly layered on top of each other rather than worn alone. fashion.Tops: Oversized tees, often with a graphic related to a band or piece of media associated with Gloomcore; Henley shirts; Collared shirts layered with oversized long-sleeve shirts; Flannel shirts
fashion.Bottoms: Corduroy pants; Overall pants and shorts; Cargo pants and shorts; Midi skirts, often with nature-related prints; Tights, especially insulated tights (may be ripped/distressed)
fashion.Outerwear: Hoodies; Knit grandpa sweaters; Corduroy jackets; Raincoats; Leather jackets
fashion.Shoes: Leather boots; Hiking shoes; Chunky sneakers; Converse/Vans; Patterned socks
fashion.Accessories: Arm and leg warmers; Beanies/toques; Satchels; Canvas backpacks; Thick tarnished rings; Layered tarnished necklaces with delicate pendants
